description: This file declares functions related to handling HTTP ETag headers in the lighttpd server. It contains function prototypes for managing cache validation via ETags and modified timestamps, and for mutating ETag strings.

methods.name: li_http_response_handle_cachable_etag
methods.description: Handles whether the HTTP response should be cacheable based on the ETag.

methods.name: li_http_response_handle_cachable_modified
methods.description: Handles cacheability based on last modified timestamp.

methods.name: li_http_response_handle_cachable
methods.description: Determines if the current request is cacheable.

methods.name: li_etag_set_header
methods.description: Sets the ETag header for the response based on file stat info.
